query: ZED प्रमाणन के लिए कौन से दस्तावेज़ आवश्यक हैं?
expected_answer: Three documents are required: the Udyam Registration Number of the enterprise, the mobile number associated with that Udyam registration, and a valid email ID, to which login credentials and documents are sent.

query: ZED प्रमाणन योजना के लिए कौन पात्र है?
expected_answer: The applicant should be a Micro, Small or Medium Enterprise (MSME) unit and should be registered on the Udyam portal.

query: ZED ब्रॉन्ज़ प्रमाणन की लागत कितनी है?
expected_answer: Certification Level 1 (Bronze) costs ₹10,000.

query: ZED सिल्वर प्रमाणन का शुल्क क्या है?
expected_answer: Certification Level 2 (Silver) costs ₹40,000.

query: ZED गोल्ड प्रमाणन की लागत कितनी है?
expected_answer: Certification Level 3 (Gold) costs ₹90,000.

query: ZED योजना में जॉइनिंग रिवॉर्ड कितना मिलता है?
expected_answer: A joining reward of ₹10,000 is provided, and the Bronze certification becomes free if it is availed.

query: परीक्षण और गुणवत्ता प्रमाणन के लिए कितनी वित्तीय सहायता मिलती है?
expected_answer: Up to 75% of the total cost of testing, quality or product certification is covered, with a maximum subsidy ceiling of ₹50,000.

query: डिज़ाइन स्कीम में छात्र परियोजना के लिए अधिकतम कितनी सहायता मिलती है?
expected_answer: Student design projects receive financial assistance of up to ₹2,50,000, with 75% of the total project cost contributed by the Government of India.

query: डिज़ाइन परियोजना में सूक्ष्म उद्यम के लिए सरकार कितना प्रतिशत योगदान देती है?
expected_answer: For approved design projects the Government of India contributes 75% of the total project cost for Micro enterprises and 60% for Small and Medium enterprises.

query: डिज़ाइन स्कीम के लिए पात्रता क्या है?
expected_answer: The beneficiary unit must be a registered micro, small or medium enterprise and must hold a valid Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) or Udyam Registration certificate.

query: MSME कौशल प्रशिक्षण योजना में प्रशिक्षुओं की आयु सीमा क्या है?
expected_answer: Trainees selected by the applicant MSME must be between 18 and 25 years of age.

query: MSME कौशल प्रशिक्षण योजना में प्रशिक्षु को कितना वजीफा मिलता है?
expected_answer: The applicant must provide the trainee a stipend of ₹5,000 per month, for a maximum of 6 months.

query: प्रौद्योगिकी अधिग्रहण सहायता के लिए क्या पूर्व अनुमोदन आवश्यक है?
expected_answer: Yes. The applicant must obtain prior approval from the MSME Commissionerate within one year of signing the MoU, and the technology must be acquired from a recognised institution or technology provider.

query: SME एक्सचेंज के माध्यम से धन जुटाने पर कितनी सहायता मिलती है?
expected_answer: 25% of the expenditure incurred on raising funds through the SME Exchange, limited to a maximum of ₹5,00,000.

query: निवेश संवर्धन योजना के लिए इकाई कहाँ स्थित होनी चाहिए?
expected_answer: The unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.

query: MSME திறன் பயிற்சி திட்டத்தில் பயிற்சியாளர்களுக்கு என்ன தகுதி தேவை?
expected_answer: Trainees must hold an engineering degree, a polytechnic diploma, or an Industrial Training Institute (ITI) certificate, or a qualification prescribed by the respective sector skill council.

query: MSME திறன் பயிற்சி மற்றும் வேலைவாய்ப்பு திட்டத்திற்கு நிதி வழங்குவது யார்?
expected_answer: The scheme is funded by the Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation, and the applicant must be an MSME unit in the state.

query: ZED சான்றிதழ் திட்டத்திற்கு யார் தகுதியானவர்?
expected_answer: The applicant should be a Micro, Small or Medium Enterprise (MSME) unit and should be registered on the Udyam portal.

query: ZED சான்றிதழுக்கு என்ன ஆவணங்கள் தேவை?
expected_answer: The Udyam Registration Number of the enterprise, the mobile number associated with that Udyam registration, and a valid email ID.

query: வடிவமைப்புத் திட்டத்தில் மாணவர் திட்டத்திற்கு அதிகபட்சம் எவ்வளவு நிதி உதவி கிடைக்கும்?
expected_answer: Student design projects receive financial assistance of up to ₹2,50,000, with 75% of the total project cost contributed by the Government of India.

query: ZED certification ke liye kya documents chahiye?
expected_answer: Three documents are required: the Udyam Registration Number of the enterprise, the mobile number linked to that Udyam registration, and a valid email ID.

query: Mera Gujarat mein small manufacturing unit hai, technology acquisition assistance ke liye eligible hun kya?
expected_answer: A micro, small or medium enterprise may apply, but the technology must be acquired from a recognised institution or technology provider and prior approval must be obtained from the MSME Commissionerate within one year of signing the MoU. Eligibility cannot be confirmed without those two facts.

query: Design scheme mein student project ke liye kitna paisa milta hai?
expected_answer: Up to ₹2,50,000 for student design projects, with 75% of the total project cost contributed by the Government of India.

query: MSME skill training scheme mein trainee ki age limit kya hai?
expected_answer: Trainees must be between 18 and 25 years of age.

query: SME exchange pe listing karne pe kitni subsidy milti hai?
expected_answer: 25% of the expenditure incurred on raising funds through the SME Exchange, subject to a maximum of ₹5,00,000.
